decisions.reason: As a direct extension of the firm's filtration and process-media portfolio, the centrifuge still offers learning value and cross-selling potential at relatively low incremental retention cost.

The scraper belt chip conveyor is somewhat more exposed to pruning because it is adjacent rather than fully central to the core offer, but its fit with broader chip-handling system solutions still justifies keeping the option open.
The magnetic belt chip conveyor strengthens an established chip-conveying range and service network, so its continued market presence is a low-risk complementary option worth retaining.

The hinged belt chip conveyor faces some overlap and should continue to be tested against demand and margin evidence, yet for a large machinery supplier it remains valuable to keep as part of a broad application-specific portfolio.
